What the studio does

Custom designs

Bring an idea or reference sketches. Customers write that the artists explain what will work best and turn it into a design of your own.

Cover-ups and reworks

Old tattoos covered or brought back to life and colour, with suggestions on how to improve the design.

Sleeves and large pieces

From small fine-line pieces to full sleeves and large-scale work, as the photos and reviews show.

Your first tattoo

45 Google reviews are about a first tattoo. Customers write that they felt safe, listened to and comfortable the whole session.

Recent work

Photos the studio posted on its Google listing.

From idea to healed tattoo

How customers describe the process on Google.

Idea and sketch

A consultation to understand your idea. One customer had the sketch ready in less than half an hour.

The session

A relaxed chat, everything prepared, and a clean studio. Reviews call it smooth, professional and respectful.

Aftercare

Aftercare instructions to follow at home. One customer writes it healed faster than expected.

A studio in Oroklini

InkBox sits in Shop 10 of the Neapolis Forest Beach Estate on Dhekelia Road, under the big TATTOO letters and the black ink box. On Google, customers mention the comfortable atmosphere more than anything else, followed by first tattoos and talented artists. The listing also marks the studio as LGBTQ+ friendly and a transgender safe space.
